disposition.rationale: The ECI 2008 consolidated PDF's exact bytes have now been acquired from an Internet Archive capture of the exact official ECI URL and independently parsed; a later official Gazette PDF recites publication notification S.O.382(E), dated 19 February 2008. These resolve prior internal schedule/table and publication-reference errors. Neither the consolidated ECI PDF nor a later Gazette recital is a substitute for the original 2008 Gazette issue, its exact issue metadata, or an authenticated physical/certified copy. The actual Gazette issue for O.N.55(E) and Andhra Pradesh State Gazette counterpart/certified copy remain unacquired.
